expl: The Suez Canal is an artificial sea-level waterway located in Isthmus of Suez in Egypt. It is 193.30 km long. This canal connects the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea. It became operational in 1869. Tewfik Port (Suez Port) is located to the south of Suez Canal and Port Said is located to its north. It is the largest artificial navigational canal in the world. Suez Canal reduced the maritime distance between Europe and India by 7,000 km.

This canal has significantly reduced the distance between San Francisco (on the western coast) and New York (on the eastern coast).
